feeds.title: GAMEDESIGNING - Become a Video Game Designer
feeds.description: The aspiring video game designers guide to becoming a successful game designer, developer, or artist.

feeds.title: Raph Koster
feeds.description: A professional game designer and frequent writer on issues of interactive design, Raph Koster was the lead designer on the seminal online world ULTIMA ONLINE, which first brought online worlds to the mass market.

feeds.title: 2D Game Art Guru News
feeds.description: 2Dgameartguru.com shares tutorials, tips and tricks about game art creation, designing with open source tools like Inkscape, Krita and Gimp.

feeds.title: Keith Burgun
feeds.description: Keith Burgun is a game designer, writer, composer and visual artist from Westchester, NY. He has written two books on game design and he is a founder of Dinofarm Games.

feeds.title: Games by Manuel Correia Blog
feeds.description: Manuel Correia is a game designer of both digital and analog games. You might have played one of the games He worked on while at InnoGames, Gambrinous, Digital Furnace, SixMinute, Miniclip or Gameinvest.

feeds.title: The Board Game Design Lab
feeds.description: The Board Game Design Lab was created for one purpose: to help you design great games people love. To accomplish that goal, this podcast interviews designers, publishers, and board game insiders on specific topics related to game design. I don't waste time talking about recently played games or pop culture. Instead, the show does a deep dive into subjects that I hope you'll find extremely valuable as you progress through your game design journey.

feeds.title: Ludology
feeds.description: Welcome to Ludology, an analytical discussion of the how's and why's of the world of board games. Rather than news and reviews, Ludology explores a variety of topics about games from a wider lens, and discusses game history, game design and game players.Ludology is part of The Dice Tower Network, the premier board game media network.

feeds.title: League of GameMakers
feeds.description: A blog about making tabletop games from a diverse group of designers, publishers, developers and artists.

feeds.title: Sirlin.Net - Game Design
feeds.description: Sirlin designed video games such as Street Fighter HD Remix, Puzzle Fighter HD Remix, and Kongai. He's designed tabletop games such as Yomi, Puzzle Strike, Pandante, and Flash Duel. He discusses the craft of game design with his lead playtester.

feeds.title: Daniel Solis Blog
feeds.description: Daniel Solis is a multiple award-winning game designer. Creator of Belle of the Ball (Dice Hate Me Games); Kodama: the Tree Spirits (Action Phase Games); Princess Bride: As You Wish (GameSalute); Spycraft: Need To Know (Crafty Games); and many more self-published card games! This blog is mostly about game design, graphic design, typography and art direction.

feeds.title: Game Design Aspect
feeds.description: Sande Chen is a writer and game designer whose game credits span 10 years in the industry. Her writing credits include 1999 Independent Games Festival winner Terminus and the PC RPG of the Year, The Witcher, for which she was nominated for a 2007 Writers Guild Award in Videogame Writing.

feeds.title: No Hidden Info
feeds.description: A strategy game design and programming blog. This blog is a place to show friends and interested parties an ideas on strategy game design and programming.

feeds.title: Molecular Jig Games Blog
feeds.description: Molecular Jig Games is for to increase general knowledge of molecular behavior. Proteins, lipids, drugs, allergens, vaccines, degradable plastic, ocean acidification, heath: molecules are the key to understanding many important concepts. The goal will be accomplish by creating games that take place in the molecular world and making them available to as wide an audience as possible.

feeds.title: Tien Tam - Game Design Blog
feeds.description: Tien Tam is a 3D Generalist and Game Designer with a focus on creating engaging content. Excels at cross-disciplinary collaboration to create, implement, and deliver optimized game assets.

feeds.title: The Game Crafter Official Podcast
feeds.description: A weekly podcast hosted by JT Smith and Jeff King that covers news, events, tips, and helpful advice on utilizing the print on demand services of The Game Crafter.

feeds.title: Design a Game
feeds.description: Pietro Polsinelli is a game designer and developer, mostly working on applied (a.k.a. educational) games. He try to present the projects he has worked on, past and present; he also try to define some features of the future ones, at least, the ones he hope to do; in that section he also briefly present some of his skills and defects.

feeds.title: Kind Fortress
feeds.description: This blog is all about board game design. Isaac Shalev is Board-gamer, game designer, host of On Board Games.

feeds.title: Designer Notes
feeds.description: This blog is about Soren Johnson's Game Design Journal.

feeds.title: Games Precipice
feeds.description: A blog exploring the depths of tabletop game design. Featuring a monthly topic and weekly subtopics, we examine design steps, concepts, mechanics, implementation and use editorials to help new and aspiring game designers improve their ideas.
